_comment: What tools/package-batch.js puts in this batch's upload package (batches/2026-10-a/upload/). Order matters: website patches first, then the batch diffs. The sitemap and llms.txt entries are not kept here as diffs; the script makes them from the built pages, so they always match the current specs.

notApplied.speed.patch: Already on the live branch (deployed 2026-10-05, in its own revised form).
notApplied.contrast.patch: Already on the live branch (deployed 2026-10-05, in its own revised form).

copyAs.why: The story check the first versions of the kit loaded from specs/. Since 2026-10-13 the kit's story() lives in tools/page-kit.js, which loads tools/story-check.js from beside it (in the website, tools/blog-brain/tools/). Kept so the shipped copy matches; copied fresh on every build so it never drifts.

agree._comment: Every dollar figure in each row of this data file must appear in the hub's table row that links to the same page (WORKFLOW rule: one fact, one value). The pages build their comparison table from the same file.

changes: `/buyers/55-plus-communities/` (the hub): links to the four pages, and its figures for the four communities now match the pages and `data/55-plus-communities.json` (resale prices, HOA fees, home counts). The gate claims for Seasons at Prince Creek West and Del Webb at Grande Dunes are gone: no primary 2026 source calls either one gated. The Seasons page says only what recent listings show: a gate at the main entrance on TPC Boulevard, with a call box for visitors (version 14).
`/buyers/retirees/` and `/buyers/golf-communities/`: the same gate claims, removed. The Blackmoor story on the golf page now says only what the story bank records.
`sitemap.xml`: the four pages, with their photos (Google image sitemap).
`llms.txt`: the four pages, with their descriptions; the hub's fee range now reads "from $43/mo".
`llms-full.txt`: regenerated by `node build.js llmsfull`, so it carries the four pages' text and the corrected hub.
`tools/mkpage.js` and the stylesheets: the six website patches (see Blog-Brain `website-patches/README.md`).
afterDeploy: {site}/buyers/55-plus-communities/: the table links to the four pages, and its price and HOA fee for each match that page's comparison table. No sentence says Seasons or Del Webb at Grande Dunes is gated.
{site}/buyers/retirees/: the first FAQ answer says Del Webb at Grande Dunes has indoor and outdoor pools, a lifestyle director and a beach club in the HOA dues, and does not say "gated".
{site}/buyers/golf-communities/: no sentence says Seasons is gated.
